notes: 41 ABI functions (incl. 2 constants and proxiableUUID) plus the fallback ('revert') reviewed. Reviewed by structure (control flow, calls, storage writes, events, reverts, loops) because of their size: getConfiguredTokenOracles (~6,000 lines), getPrice and getPriceDetailed (~4,400 each), _getPriceImplNoWrite (~1,950), getPricesRawForMode, getPriceRawForMode, setAltSourceConfig, setAdditionalSourceConfig, setAdditionalAltSourceConfig (setSourceConfig read in full). Same code: getPriceDetailed = getPrice + 2 storage reads; getPriceDetailedView = getPriceView + 2 reads; setAdditional*/setAlt* = setSourceConfig's validation and writes on other slots; remove*SourceConfig share the _revertIfTokenKeysBlockAltRemoval loop (8 copies). No semantic error found on the paths shown: checked all error codes against errorTypes.sol, every storage write offset against the layout (TokenSources bit offsets, altSrc = slot+3), the sequencer do-while loops, removeConfig's swap-and-pop, setPriceMode's multisig rules, the UUPS paths. Loops: 7 explicit (2 sequencer do-whiles inlined 15 times, _tokenHasEmodeInConfigsMap, _revertIfTokenKeysBlockAltRemoval, removeConfig, getPricesRawForMode, getConfiguredTokenOracles), all readable whiles; the sequencer loops are live in the text although the feed address is the zero immutable. The other 84 whiles are implicit: 59 checked-exp helpers, configsMap storage-to-memory copy, new ConfiguredTokenOracle[] init (rotated, P3: 130 lines peeled), 3 array return copies (P7), the struct-array ABI encode loop. P2 counted with log data and keccak inputs (header regex: 292). P16 here is a dynamic calldata array (tokens_[i] as cd[32 * idx + _param1 + 36]). P13: tokenConfig names _tokenSources after getTokenConfig. Event/error names are raw topics/selectors (not in the signature DB).
summary: Faithful on every path shown, but the main pricing logic is mostly lost to aborts (all alt/fallback/deviation and multi-source paths), and what is shown is buried under raw memory (no free-memory-pointer reasoning), 59 always-panicking exponent loops and ~2,000 lines of arm duplication.
